stories.title: Sources: Eagles QB Hurts placed on IR, expected to be out indefinitely
stories.summary: The Eagles have decided to place Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations with numerous doctors and experts, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

stories.title: Florida puts No. 7 Texas' CFP hopes in peril with upset in Austin
stories.summary: Florida quarterback Tramell Jones Jr. helped the Gators rally to beat No. 7 Texas 27-24 and hand the Longhorns their second consecutive loss.

stories.title: Alabama WR Coleman-Williams undergoes arthroscopic knee surgery
stories.summary: Alabama star wide receiver Ryan Coleman-Williams underwent arthroscopic knee surgery to repair a meniscus injury, according to ESPN's Katie George.

stories.title: Steelers lose receiver Wilson to IR, Metcalf comes off injury report
stories.summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers placed Roman Wilson on the injured reserve list, their second key receiver lost to injury in as many weeks.

stories.title: Maresca plays down Haaland injury fears after City star limps off
stories.summary: Enzo Maresca has played down fears over Erling Haaland's fitness after the striker limped off at the end of Manchester City's 3-2 win over Ipswich.
